v: tatastu nIlo vijayI mahAbalaH; praSasyamAnaH svakftena karmaRA
sametya rAmeRa salakzmaRena; prahfzwarUpastu baBUva yUTapaH
anvehi mAmeva niSAcarendra; na vAnarAMstvaM prati yodDumarhasi
gamizyasi tvaM daSa vA diSo vA; taTApi me nAdya gato vimokzyase
sa tattadA sUrya ivABrajAlaM; praviSya rakzo'DipaterniveSanam
SriyaM ca kIrtiM ca ciraM samaSnute
vaDAya rOdrasya nfSaMsakarmaRas; tadA mahAtmA tvaritaM nirIkzate
aTendrajidrAkzasaBUtaye tu; juhAva havyaM viDinA viDAnavat
dfzwvA vyatizWanta ca rAkzasAste; mahAsamUhezu nayAnayajYAH
samAptakarmA hi sa rAkzasendro; BavatyadfSyaH samare surAsurEH
yuyutsatA tena samAptakarmaRA; BavetsurARAmapi saMSayo mahAn
dadarSa taM parvatasaMnikASaM; raTasTitaM BImabalaM durAsadam
na ca tvaM na ca te pitA
hfzwA baBUvuryuDi yUTapendrA; niSamya taM SakrajitaM nipAtitam
sA hi janma ca bAlyaM ca
jagAma harzaM ca parAM ca nirvftiM;
mahI cakampe na ca mArutA vavuH;
